Sample.evidence_source: At Time 1 (Spring, May 2016), 424 migrant adolescents completed anonymous self-report questionnaires with the class as the unit. At Time 2 (Spring, May 2017), 276 of the 424 (65.09%) migrant adolescents continued and completed our investigation. Although the adolescents who dropped reported less negative emotion (M=2.02) at T1 than those who participated at T2 (M=2.17, t (416)=−2.25, p=0.03)

country.evidence_source: All participants were early adolescents (aged 10–14 years) migrating from rural hometowns to urban areas with their parents for at least 6 months. All the participants were recruited in a migrant school from diferent senior grades in Beijing, China.
